definition: Public development cases frozen before product filter changes. Required and avoided strings are case-insensitive literal phrases in the pinned label plus description. An empty category means all; unknown categories must produce no matches, never all.
planning_controls: All selected stops must satisfy category, require and avoid predicates before distance sorting and truncation.
Origin is excluded; all stops lie inside the radius; ties sort by source ID.
Zero radius from Washington Monument with museum preference yields no candidates.
Conflicting history/history preferences yield no candidates without silent relaxation.
NaN, infinity, negative radius, invalid origin, invalid stop limit are rejected.
Every selected ID has an inspection button; actual dialog includes pinned revision, coordinates, source hash, rights and stale-hours/unavailable-routing disclosures.
